blocks.x: Applied AI & GenAI, tuned for Omnichannel Retail: sector-specific design decisions, the delivery pattern with named owners, and outcomes gated on signed metrics.

Omnichannel retail wins on promise-keeping: availability, delivery promise, price consistency and service resolution across channels. The decision infrastructure behind those promises — demand sensing, allocation, pricing — decides margin before marketing spends a cent.

items: Consent and profiling governance is not yet defined; personalization ships as generic segments.
Forecasts update weekly while baskets shift daily; markdowns and stockouts both inherit the lag.

Governance inherits the sector frame — GDPR/CCPA among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Retail & Consumer Goods level this capability reads as: streaming signals (sales, weather, local events, search) into daily SKU-location forecasts (forecast error down 20-35%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

A fixed rhythm keeps progress visible from week one — here is the one we run. Weeks 1–2 belong to measurement: the baseline metric is captured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 run a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — steered by a control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 convert the pilot into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, and close with a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses a gate is stopped or redirected on the record.
